soundness_flags.label: Definitions of Ubi/DMG and Theorems 1–2
soundness_flags.one_line: The stated “all finite DMGs” class excludes bidirected loops, whereas the cited DMG literature permits loops of either edge type; therefore the claimed all-DMG extension does not match its quantified graph class.

soundness_flags.label: def:profile-saturation and Proposition 1
soundness_flags.one_line: “fixed mixed SCC-profile family,” “incoming-to-SCC support,” and the completion rule are not formally defined, so Γ(G) and the asserted family are not yet uniquely determined objects.

source_verification_receipts.locator: Definition 2.1 (p. 66); Proposition 3.1 (p. 69); Theorem 3.12 (p. 71); Proposition 3.22 and the all-DMG conjecture (p. 74); Discussion (p. 75).
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper proves a greatest E-equivalent representative for directed graphs, permits only the stated occupied-rectangle bidirected addition, and explicitly conjectures a greatest element for every E-separation DMG equivalence class; its DMG definition permits directed and bidirected loops.

source_verification_receipts.locator: Section 2.3, pp. 544–545; Theorem 5.9 and Section 5.5, pp. 555–556.
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper defines DMGs with directed and bidirected edges, permits loops, and constructs the μ-separation maximal representative/DMEG from independence relations.
The paper establishes a transformational characterization for Markov-equivalent directed maximal ancestral graphs, not cyclic E-separation DMGs.
The paper gives conditions and a polynomial-time algorithm for Markov equivalence of maximal ancestral graphs.
The paper proves soundness and completeness of FCI for simple σ-faithful cyclic SCMs for specified causal and cycle features; it does not state an E-greatest-DMG theorem.
The proceedings paper presents an efficient procedure for d-separation Markov equivalence of directed graphs with or without cycles, not E-separation DMGs.
The preprint gives an integer-programming framework for exact graph learning and globally optimal solutions to its encoded learning problem; it does not claim E-equivalence union closure.

The preprint develops separable and essentially separable graphical models, canonical equivalence-class representations, and an identification algorithm under suitable assumptions; this is a different vertex-separation framework.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Redefine Ubi as the full unordered-pair quotient including {v,v}, then explicitly extend Lift, Γ, R, transfer, saturation, and recovery to bidirected loops so the headline really settles the published all-DMG conjecture.
Replace the prose definition of Γ with an edgewise set-builder definition of the SCC profile and prove that its output is a DMG before using it in Proposition 1.

Add a small worked E-DMG with a bidirected loop and an SCC-changing arrow, calculating its lift and the intended Γ output, to make the unrestricted regime and proposed replacement certificates testable.

recommended_next_step: Revise the graph universe and formal saturation map, then retain the unrestricted E-transfer/greatest-representative kernel for Stage 0.
